metadata.title: Why Robinhood CEO’s $43 Million Stock Sale Isn’t What It Seems<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Robinhood CEO’s $43 Million Stock Sale Isn’t What It Seems
Speculation flared last week after a viral social media post declared that Tenev had “sold his shares — now he has zero,” suggesting that the CEO had abandoned his stake in the company. That interpretation falls short of reality.
